summary: Reconcile the existing synchronous, fake-backed conversation triage implementation with PBI 3; verify the Alembic schema revision, make only changes justified by verified gaps, and validate with isolated backend tests.
inScope: backend/app/alembic/versions/ (inspect and modify only if the triage migration is absent or incomplete)
outOfScope: Live provider integration, provider credentials, external calls, or paid requests
Retry policies beyond the existing zero-retry behavior
Applying migrations to development or production databases
validation: Inspect the Alembic revision history and compare it with the triage model fields and all-or-none constraint.
Run backend/tests/test_triage_service.py through the isolated test runner with a disposable SQLite database.
Run backend/tests/api/routes/test_conversations.py through the isolated test runner with a disposable SQLite database.
Review the final diff for provider integration, credentials, sensitive logging, unintended files, and unsafe database targets.
stopConditions: The migration state cannot be safely verified without touching a non-disposable database.
Source or migration evidence materially contradicts the approved scope or existing behavior.
A proposed change requires provider integration, credentials, external calls, or paid requests.
A material acceptance-criteria gap requires a new product decision.
decisions: Treat the existing triage route, service, schema, and tests as present; reconcile and fill verified gaps instead of reimplementing them.
Keep triage synchronous, deterministic-fake-backed, and provider-free.
Successful retriage replaces the prior result; failed retriage preserves it; changing the transcript invalidates the derived result.
